name: Tag Toolkit
overview: Manage item tags and discover popular tags in Jellyfin Web.
description: Adds an administrator-only tag editor to movie, series, episode, and music album detail pages, plus an optional home-page row of the most used tags. Loads automatically without editing web files or installing a JavaScript injector. Requires Jellyfin 10.11.x and its bundled web client.

versions.changelog: Add plugin settings and an optional user-scoped popular-tags row to Jellyfin Web.
Installable server plugin with automatic web integration, tag-only updates, and stale-edit protection.
